content: {"praised":["Intricate intersecting stories of nobility and servants enthrall viewers.","Slow, character-driven pace highlights charming everyday moments.","Strong acting brings beloved and despised characters to life.","Elegant costume drama showcases rich period visuals.","Engaging themes of class and family resonate deeply."],"criticized":["Season 2 faltered, leading to disappointment in season 3.","Frequent character deaths feel like plot manipulation.","Predictable twists and tired plot devices reduce excitement.","Repetitive drudgery, especially with Edith, hampers engagement.","Story pacing feels uneven, with abrupt changes."]}
